name: book-companion-reader
description: Obsidian plugin: PDF & EPUB reader with AI explanations, language learning, linked notes and handwriting.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production && node esbuild.config.mjs preview && node esbuild.config.mjs test
scripts.selftest: node esbuild.config.mjs test && node test/out/selftest.js --self-test selftest.json

author: Volodymyr Pavlyshyn
